name: Anisotropic Total Variation Proximal Operator
definition: A regularizer based on the ℓ1 norm of the image gradient, assuming images are sparse in the gradient domain. The proximal operator is the soft thresholding function applied to each element of the volume gradient.
summary: The Anisotropic Total Variation Proximal Operator denoises volume gradients by applying soft-thresholding to individual axis-aligned components, preserving sharp edges along principal directions unlike isotropic methods.
